target.title: docs(xai): note consumer video endpoint (imagine-video-gen on grok.com) until developer API is available
target.body:
# docs(xai): note consumer video endpoint (imagine-video-gen on grok.com) until developer API is available

## Problem
`video_generate` with any `grok-imagine-video*` model currently fails.

The `xai` video provider only implements the developer API (`api.x.ai/v1/videos/generations`), which returns 404 even with valid `xai-` keys that have video permissions.

## Evidence / Proof (2026-07-09)

```
$ openclaw video-generate --model xai/grok-imagine-video-1.5 "test prompt"
Error: xAI video generation failed (HTTP 404)
```

The working consumer flow (observed on console.xai.com) uses:

- `POST https://grok.com/rest/media/post/create`
- `modelName: "imagine-video-gen"`
- `mediaType: "MEDIA_POST_TYPE_VIDEO"`

Authentication is via Grok web session cookies.

## Change
This PR updates `docs/providers/xai.md` to document the current reality and the working consumer endpoint so users are not surprised by 404s.

## Relation to previous PRs
- #103036 and #103050 were closed because they only committed a root `PR_DESCRIPTION.md` artifact.
- This PR contains a real, publishable change to the documentation with embedded reproduction proof.

## Suggested next steps for maintainers
- Update the `xai` video provider to support the consumer `grok.com/rest/media/post/create` surface, or
- Clearly mark video generation as "consumer web only" until the developer API is available.

---

**Note:** This is a documentation-only PR (XS) with proof included in the change itself.
